name: browser-flowgo
description: Chrome/Firefox extension: render ```flowgo fenced code blocks in-page on any site (chatgpt.com, claude.ai, docs, GitHub, ...) using flowgo's shared, read-only inline renderer (../src/render/inline.ts).

scripts.package: pnpm run build && zip -j browser-flowgo-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json popup.html content.js popup.js icon-16.png icon-48.png icon-128.png
